book: Please find attached your statement of account as of 31 March 2026.

family.ex: Please state the invoice number in the transfer reference.
family.ar: لو سمحت اذكر رقم الفاتورة في مرجع التحويل.
family.ex2: As stated on the PO, delivery is to the head office.
family.ar2: زي ما هو مذكور في الـ‎PO‎، التسليم للمكتب الرئيسي.

family.ex: Our bank statement shows the transfer on 12 March.
family.ar: كشف حساب البنك عندنا فيه التحويل يوم 12 مارس.
family.ex2: The statement did not show the invoice number.

family.ex: Please find attached your statement of account as of 31 March.
family.ex2: The statement of account shows two open invoices.

syn.note: short form used inside finance teams
syn.ex: I'll send the SOA to Delta Pharma today.
syn.ar: هبعت كشف الحساب لـ‎Delta Pharma‎ النهارده.

syn.note: same meaning, a bit less formal
syn.ex: Can you send me our account statement for Q1?
syn.ar: ممكن تبعتلي كشف حسابنا للربع الأول؟
syn.ex2: The account statement helps us plan payments.

syn.note: the full internal record; customers receive the statement
syn.ex: Our accountant checked the customer ledger.
syn.ar: المحاسب بتاعنا راجع دفتر حساب العميل.
syn.ex2: The ledger shows every invoice and payment.

ctx: Please find attached your statement of account as of 30 June. The open balance is EGP 96,900 for INV-0538.
ctx_ar: مرفق كشف حسابكم لحد 30 يونيو. الرصيد المفتوح 96,900 جنيه لفاتورة ‎INV-0538.‎

quiz.s: Please send us our ___ as of 30 June.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت ابعتلنا كشف حسابنا لحد 30 يونيو.

quiz.s: Please ___ the PO number in the transfer reference.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت اذكر رقم الـ‎PO‎ في مرجع التحويل.

quiz.s: Our accountant checks the customer ___ before sending the SOA.
quiz.ar: المحاسب بتاعنا بيراجع دفتر حساب العميل قبل ما يبعت الكشف.

book: We do not agree with this balance.

family.ex2: Please arrange payment of the balance this month.
family.ar2: لو سمحت جهّز دفع الرصيد الشهر ده.

family.ex: The figures don't balance; one payment is missing.
family.ar: الأرقام مش مظبوطة؛ فيه دفعة ناقصة.
family.ex2: After the reconciliation, the accounts balance.

family.ex: The load on the three UPS phases is not balanced.
family.ar: الحمل على التلات فازات بتاعة الـ‎UPS‎ مش متوازن.
family.ex2: A balanced load protects the inverter.

meanings.m: amount still owed on an account
meanings.ex: According to our records, the balance is EGP 96,900.
meanings.ex2: It is for the replacement batteries.

meanings.ex: Our bank balance was not enough on 15 February.
meanings.ar: رصيدنا في البنك مكانش كافي يوم 15 فبراير.
meanings.ex2: That's why the cheque was returned.

meanings.ex: They will pay EGP 50,000 now and the balance by 16 July.
meanings.ar: هيدفعوا 50 ألف دلوقتي والباقي قبل 16 يوليو.

meanings.m: equal spread of weight or load
meanings.ex: Our engineer checked the phase balance on the UPS.
meanings.ar: المهندس بتاعنا راجع توازن الفازات على الـ‎UPS.‎
meanings.ex2: Good balance means longer equipment life.
meanings.ar2: التوازن الكويس معناه عمر أطول للجهاز.

syn.ex: The outstanding amount on INV-0538 is EGP 96,900.
syn.ex2: Please settle the outstanding amount this month.
syn.ar2: لو سمحت سدّد المبلغ المتبقي الشهر ده.

syn.note: simple; what is left after a part payment
syn.ex: The remaining amount will be paid on 16 July.
syn.ex2: After that, the remaining amount is zero.

ctx: According to our records, the open balance is EGP 96,900. Could you please confirm that you agree with this balance?
ctx_ar: حسب سجلاتنا، الرصيد المفتوح 96,900 جنيه. ممكن تأكّد إنك موافق على الرصيد ده؟

quiz.s: The load on the three UPS phases is not ___.
quiz.ar: الحمل على التلات فازات بتاعة الـ‎UPS‎ مش متوازن.

quiz.s: The figures don't ___; one payment is missing.
quiz.ar: الأرقام مش مظبوطة؛ فيه دفعة ناقصة.

book: We have now allocated it to INV-0512 and attached the revised statement.

family.ex: We have now allocated the payment to INV-0512.
family.ex2: Next time, we can allocate it the same day if the reference is clear.
family.ar2: المرة الجاية نقدر نوزّعها في نفس اليوم لو المرجع واضح.

family.ex: The budget allocation for spare parts is EGP 200,000.
family.ar: الميزانية المخصصة لقطع الغيار 200 ألف جنيه.
family.ex2: The allocation is reviewed every quarter.

family.ex: All allocated payments appear on the revised statement.
family.ar: كل الدفعات اللي اتوزعت ظاهرة في الكشف المعدّل.
family.ex2: The allocated amount reduced the balance to EGP 96,900.
family.ar2: المبلغ اللي اتوزّع قلّل الرصيد لـ96,900 جنيه.

family.ex: The transfer had no invoice number, so it stayed unallocated.
family.ar: التحويل مكانش فيه رقم فاتورة، ففضل مش متوزّع.
family.ex2: Unallocated payments make the balance look wrong.
family.ar2: الدفعات اللي مش متوزعة بتخلّي الرصيد شكله غلط.

meanings.m: match a payment to an invoice
meanings.ex: Please allocate the EGP 57,000 transfer to INV-0512.
meanings.ar: لو سمحت وزّع تحويل الـ57 ألف على ‎INV-0512.‎
meanings.ex2: Then send the client a revised statement.

meanings.ex: Management allocated two engineers to the data centre project.
meanings.ar: الإدارة خصصت مهندسين لمشروع الداتا سنتر.
meanings.ex2: They will stay on site for three weeks.

syn.note: accounting: apply a payment to an invoice
syn.ex: We applied the payment to the oldest invoice first.
syn.ar: طبّقنا الدفعة على أقدم فاتورة الأول.
syn.ex2: The rest was applied to INV-0538.

syn.note: connect a payment with its invoice
syn.ex: Our system could not match the transfer to any invoice.
syn.ar: السيستم مقدرش يربط التحويل بأي فاتورة.
syn.ex2: Add the invoice number so we can match it.
syn.ar2: حط رقم الفاتورة عشان نقدر نربطه.

syn.note: give a task or resource to someone
syn.ex: We assigned Eng. Mona to the Delta Pharma site.

ctx: The transfer had no invoice number, so it was recorded as unallocated. We have now allocated it to INV-0512.
ctx_ar: التحويل مكانش فيه رقم فاتورة، فاتسجّل كدفعة مش متوزعة. دلوقتي وزّعناها على ‎INV-0512.‎

quiz.s: We have ___ the payment to INV-0512.
The transfer had no invoice number, so it stayed ___.
quiz.ar: التحويل مكانش فيه رقم فاتورة، ففضل مش متوزّع.

quiz.s: The budget ___ for spare parts is EGP 200,000.
quiz.ar: الميزانية المخصصة لقطع الغيار 200 ألف جنيه.

book: Thank you for the quick reconciliation.

family.ex: Please reconcile your records with our statement.
family.ar: لو سمحت طابق سجلاتك مع الكشف بتاعنا.
family.ex2: We reconcile all customer accounts every quarter.
family.ar2: بنطابق كل حسابات العملا كل ربع سنة.

family.ex: Thank you for the quick reconciliation.
family.ex2: The reconciliation found an unallocated payment.

family.ex: The accounts are now fully reconciled.

syn.ex: After matching our records, we found the transfer.
syn.ar: بعد ما قارنّا سجلاتنا لقينا التحويل.
syn.ex2: Matching takes time without invoice numbers.
syn.ar2: المقارنة بتاخد وقت من غير أرقام فواتير.

syn.ex: Please cross-check the SOA with your bank statement.
syn.ar: لو سمحت راجع الكشف قصاد كشف البنك.
syn.ex2: The cross-check showed the missing payment.

ctx: After the reconciliation, the correct open balance is EGP 96,900. The payment of EGP 57,000 is now allocated to INV-0512.
ctx_ar: بعد المطابقة، الرصيد المفتوح الصح 96,900 جنيه. دفعة الـ57 ألف اتوزعت دلوقتي على ‎INV-0512.‎

quiz.s: Please ___ your records with our statement.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت طابق سجلاتك مع الكشف بتاعنا.

book: Once we receive it, I will release the invoice for payment in our next payment run.

family.ex: I will release the invoice for payment next week.
family.ex2: Then it goes into the payment run.

family.ex: The new firmware release fixes the UPS display bug.
family.ar: الإصدار الجديد من السوفتوير بيصلّح مشكلة شاشة الـ‎UPS.‎
family.ex2: We'll install the release during the next visit.

family.ex: The released shipment left customs this morning.
family.ar: الشحنة اللي اتفرج عنها خرجت من الجمارك الصبح.
family.ex2: The released units will reach our warehouse tonight.

meanings.ex: AP released INV-0538 for payment today.
meanings.ex2: Payment will follow in the next run.

meanings.m: let goods leave customs or a warehouse
meanings.ex: Customs released the battery shipment yesterday.
meanings.ar: الجمارك أفرجت عن شحنة البطاريات امبارح.
meanings.ex2: Delivery to site is planned for Sunday.

meanings.m: publish a new version of software
meanings.ex: The manufacturer released new firmware for the VFD.
meanings.ex2: It improves motor control at low speed.
meanings.ar2: بيحسّن التحكم في الموتور على السرعة البطيئة.

syn.ex: The Finance Manager approved the invoice on Monday.
syn.ar: المدير المالي وافق على الفاتورة يوم الاتنين.

syn.note: informal; make cash or resources available
syn.ex: Collecting INV-0538 will free up cash for imports.
syn.ex2: It will also free up our credit limit.

ant.ex: The invoice is on hold until we get the signed delivery note.
ant.ar: الفاتورة موقوفة لحد ما ناخد إذن التسليم الممضي.
ant.ex2: We cannot pay invoices on hold.

ant.ex: The system blocked the payment because of a missing PO.
ant.ar: السيستم وقف الدفع عشان الـ‎PO‎ مش موجود.
ant.ex2: AP unblocked it after the PO arrived.
ant.ar2: الحسابات فكّته بعد ما الـ‎PO‎ وصل.

ctx: INV-0538 is on hold because the signed delivery note is missing. Once we receive it, I will release the invoice for payment.
ctx_ar: ‎INV-0538‎ موقوفة عشان إذن التسليم الممضي مش موجود. أول ما نستلمه، هعتمد الفاتورة للدفع.
